_comment: Typical published United award level per destination region and cabin, one-way from SFO. DERIVED FROM OBSERVED DATA, not hand-guessed: each value is the modal (most frequently occurring) price in data/deals.json for that region+cabin. A row priced below its baseline is genuinely unusual and worth surfacing.
_method: mode of observed miles per region+cabin
_caveat: United partner award pricing is close to FIXED in premium cabins: Asia First is 220000 in 100% of observed rows, Europe Business 88000 in 80%, Asia Premium Economy 65000 in 92%. Those cabins will therefore essentially never fall below baseline. Economy is the only cabin with real price variation (Europe 56% at mode, Asia 31%). This is a property of the award chart, not a bug. For premium cabins the scarce resource is AVAILABILITY, not price.
_note: Oceania has no Business or First availability at all in the observed window, so no baseline exists for those cabins.
_regenerate: Recompute the modes from data/deals.json after a refresh if the award chart changes.
